Your products may already be listed on AEC Integrations. Free lets you keep that listing accurate. Managed lets you tell the full story: how teams use each product, which trades and phases it serves, and which data flows you confirm.

<!-- docs:plans-actions -->

## Compare plans

<!-- docs:plans-comparison -->

## What every plan includes

On Free and on Managed, anyone with a seat can:

- keep your company details current: the description, website, headquarters, logo and contact links,
- keep each product's description, website, logo and categories current,
- claim and maintain the integrations your company builds, add your own links, and request a change to a detail on one you do not own,
- answer reviews of your products in public, so buyers see your side. We check each reply before it goes live. See [Replying to reviews](/docs/vendors/replying-to-reviews),
- invite colleagues and manage seats. See [Your seat](/docs/vendors/your-seat),
- work through the company and product checklists. See [Your checklists](/docs/vendors/checklists).

[Editing your profile and products](/docs/vendors/editing-profile-and-products) lists every field and how it saves.

The company name and the product names are not edited in the portal.

The product details on this list are the ones that feed search ranking. They are editable on Free for that reason. [How ranking works](/docs/trust/how-ranking-works) explains how they count.

## What Managed adds

- **How teams use it.** Show buyers, in your own words, what your product does on a real project.
- **Trades, audiences and phases.** Set the trades, audiences and project phases each product serves, so its listing describes it accurately.
- **Integrations page and API docs links.** Send evaluators straight from your listing to your docs. They show under **Resources** on your product page.
- **Confirmed data flows.** Say which data moves in each of your integrations. Your answer counts toward the integration's agreement label, the same as your partner's. See [Confirming integration data](/docs/vendors/confirming-integration-data).
- **Search engine notice.** We tell search engines each time you update a public page.

On Free, your edits still go live straight away, and search engines find them on their own schedule through our sitemap. Telling a search engine about a page does not decide whether it crawls, indexes or ranks that page. The search engine decides that.

On a Free product, the Managed fields stay visible in the portal. They are read-only, and each one says it is part of Managed.

## Why buyers trust the order

Every listing is sorted by the same published rules. Your plan is not part of that. Neither is anything else you pay for.

Your plan also never decides:

- whether a review is published or removed,
- whether a listing exists,
- how an agreement label is worked out. Both companies' answers count the same.

Each plan panel in your portal says the same: "No plan changes where you rank or appear, or whether a review is published." [How ranking works](/docs/trust/how-ranking-works) sets out the full rule and how we check it.

## When a Managed plan ends

- Each product whose subscription ends moves to Free. Your seats, sign-in and portal stay.
- Nothing you entered is removed. Your listings stay published.
- When a product's subscription ends, the public line under its Managed fields and "How teams use it" changes to "Maintained by" your company "until" the end date. [Editing your profile and products](/docs/vendors/editing-profile-and-products) explains the line.
- When a product's subscription ends, its pages show a banner with the end date. When your last subscription ends, one banner covers the whole portal. Owners see a **Go to Billing** button.
- Everything in "What every plan includes" keeps working, the checklists included.
- Everything in "What Managed adds" stays just as you left it. You can edit it again once the product holds a subscription.
- We stop telling search engines about changes to that product. Your edits still go live.
- An integration delivered through a connector that you already claimed stays claimed. One you retired stays retired. Open change requests on one move to AEC Integrations.
- Each product's checklist counts three steps again, as on Free. See [Your checklists](/docs/vendors/checklists).

## Getting Managed

Managed is sold per product. One subscription covers one product, and an owner puts it on the product on the Billing tab. When a subscription ends, its product moves to Free. Its Managed fields stay just as you left them. If you want to change them in the future, you will need to purchase a subscription to do so.

<!-- docs:plans-cta -->

To start, claim your listing. The claim form does not ask about a plan. When we approve a claim, every product is on Free, and nothing is billed. An owner can then pay for subscriptions by card on the Billing tab, through Stripe, billed yearly or monthly, with tax added where it applies. Then the owner puts a subscription on each product you want on Managed. See [Billing](/docs/vendors/billing#paying-by-card). If your company already holds subscriptions, a new seat does not change them. See [Claiming your vendor listing](/docs/vendors/claiming-your-listing).

An annual subscription renews each year unless you opt out before the renewal date. Forty-five days before that date, we email every seat and your billing email the date, the price, the subscription count and any change to the terms. A new price never applies mid-term.

The portal shows your plan's status, and the end date where there is one. Forty-five days before the end date, everyone with a seat, your billing email and AEC Integrations get an email with the date, the price, your subscription count and any change to the Managed plan agreement. Nothing changes before that date. On the renewal date, annual card billing renews. A plan that you opted out of, or one we granted, ends on its end date, and the product moves to Free. To opt out of an annual card renewal, an owner cancels it in **Manage billing in Stripe** on the Billing tab, or you can [contact us](/contact).

### Can we cancel a Managed plan early?

Yes, on the monthly plan. Monthly has no commitment: cancel any time, and your subscriptions run to the end of the month you paid for. An annual subscription runs to its renewal date. If you opt out of renewal, it ends on that date.

Cancel monthly billing in **Manage billing in Stripe** on the Billing tab, or by email to us. To opt out of an annual renewal, an owner cancels it the same way before the renewal date, or you email us. See [Billing](/docs/vendors/billing#renewal-and-cancelling).
